text: Tacit Eau de Parfum - Aesop. Created in collaboration with perfumer Céline Barel, the Yuzu-inspired citrus notes lend a radiant familiarity, while Basil delivers a uniquely green accord with delicately spicy undertones. Aroma: Fresh, citrus notes, green. Key ingredients: Yuzu, Vetiver Heart, Basil. Top notes | Yuzu, Basil Grand Vert, Clove | Middle notes | Rosemary, Mint, Fennel | Base notes | Cedarwood, Vetiver Heart, Amber
